scope: Index of publicly visible Clio UI images and videos across all product areas (clio.com product pages via Wayback, help.clio.com article images/videos via Zendesk API, App Store / Google Play, official YouTube channel @goclio).

features.name: Matter stages board
features.what: Matters move through firm-defined stages shown as a board.

features.name: Court rules calendaring
features.what: Generates deadline chains from jurisdiction rules; editable per matter.

features.name: Text messaging
features.where: Matter or contact dashboard > send text
features.what: Two-way SMS with clients logged to the matter, also on mobile.

features.name: Internal messages
features.what: Staff-to-staff messages, e.g. bill approval requests.

features.name: Protected trust funds
features.what: Funds can be marked protected so non-accounts users cannot spend them; permission-gated edit/release.

features.name: Clio for Clients portal app
features.what: Clients message, share documents, pay and complete client actions.

features.name: Clio Draft questionnaires
features.what: Client-facing multi-page questionnaires whose answers fill document templates.

features.name: Grow matter pipeline
features.what: Leads tracked across intake stages on a board.

features.name: Grow AI website chat
features.what: AI chat on firm website that captures leads.

features.name: Clio Accounting bank feed and trust withdrawal
features.what: Bank feed matching and trust withdrawal flows.

features.name: Manage AI (Duo)
features.what: Answers matter questions, drafts communications, extracts deadlines, assists billing.

features.name: Clio Work (Vincent)
features.where: Clio Work app; iOS 'Vincent by Clio'
features.what: AI legal research, document analysis, redlines, timelines, translation, Legal Pad, SEC filing search.

features.name: Tap to Pay
features.where: Mobile app > bill > Tap to Pay
features.what: Take card payments on a phone against an invoice.

features.name: Clio File e-filing
features.what: Court e-filing with status tracking, auto filing-fee expense and rules calendaring.
